title: Scanning words on demand
description: You can watch a generator retain its position and delay a later input error.

steps.description: words advances pos past spaces and runs of letters. You yield each word together with the index where it started.
An unexpected character raises ValueError when the scan reaches it. The first two requests yield ('let', 0) and ('x', 4), pausing before the question mark.

steps.question: What happens when the caller requests one more word from this generator?
steps.answer: The scan resumes, skips the next space and raises ValueError for '?' at position 6. The handler prints the error.

steps.description: You see unexpected '?' at 6 after the third request. The final for loop consumes a fresh generator for 'let x' and prints let 0 followed by x 4.
